Who we are?

[/et_pb_text][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"]

 We are specialist for garden and house projects finely crafted from Spruce and Pine wood. We use slow grown northern Europe wood which is considered the best for its strengths and quality for garden structures. With over 3200 m³ of structures production per month and over 15 years of professional services we proudly claim that we are serving more than 15 countries around the globe.

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][et_pb_row _builder_version="4.27.0" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_column type="4_4" _builder_version="4.27.0" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_image src="https://ideaswood.eu/wp-content/uploads/tituline-1.jpg" title_text="DCIM100MEDIADJI_0050.JPG" force_fullwidth="on" _builder_version="4.27.0" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][/et_pb_image][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"]
One of Our Modern and Innovative Factories
[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][et_pb_row column_structure="1_2,1_2" use_custom_gutter="on" gutter_width="2" _builder_version="4.27.0" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_column type="1_2" _builder_version="4.27.0" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.0" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"]

We supply standard or individual design wooden houses, pergolas, saunas, A-frame houses, residential timber frame houses, innovative wood and aluminium composite constructions since 2007. Active operation gives us confidence and experience to offer high quality products and services.

Modern production facility is equipped with the latest, cutting-edge machinery, allowing us to achieve a production capacity of up to 100 trucks per month. Our highly skilled team of professional engineers and production specialists carefully oversee every stage of the manufacturing process, from initial design and blueprint development to final packing and delivery. This ensures that every client order is executed with precision, quality, and timeliness.

Main production business standards:

  • Business with integrity;
  • High quality and safe products;
  • Corporate diligence;
  • Health and occupational safety;
  • Environment protection;
  • Data protection and intellectual property;
  • Client first!

Stock items ready to ship

Efficient Inventory Solutions and Optimized Delivery Timelines
We know that warehousing costs are a critical consideration for businesses. With a focus on reducing lead times and optimizing the order-to-delivery process, we offer our clients a selection of standard stock items, ready and available in our warehouse for immediate shipment. This approach ensures faster turnaround times, helping our partners stay agile and responsive to market demands also stand out from their competitors

Partner with a Leading Supplier of Wooden Garden Structures

At IdeasWood, we are always on the lookout for reliable partners worldwide to expand our markets and deliver high-quality wooden garden buildings to even more customers. With our extensive product range, including log cabins, summerhouses, saunas, camping pods, pergolas, and hot tubs, we offer exceptional opportunities for businesses looking to grow in the outdoor and garden industry.

 

[/et_pb_accordion_item][/et_pb_accordion][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][et_pb_row column_structure="3_5,2_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_column type="3_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"]

Why Partner with IdeasWood?

  • Premium Quality Products: Our wooden garden structures are crafted with precision, using top-quality materials to ensure durability and aesthetic appeal. We control all the processes to ensure supplying the best options.
  • Proven Expertise: With years of experience in the industry, we’ve established ourselves as a trusted partner in garden building design and manufacturing.
  • Flexible Cooperation Models: Whether you’re a distributor, reseller, or project developer, we offer tailored solutions to meet your business needs.
  • Comprehensive Support: From marketing materials to technical assistance, we provide all the resources you need to succeed.
  • Competitive Pricing: Our clear and transparent pricing policy and attractive terms ensure mutual profitability.
[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="2_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][et_pb_row _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_column type="4_4" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"]

Let’s Build Success Together!

If you’re interested in joining forces with a trusted supplier of wooden garden structures, contact us today. Together, we can expand our reach and deliver innovative, high-quality solutions to customers worldwide.

Contact IdeasWood Now

A single wholesale source for garden buildings

The visualisation above shows what a full IdeasWood line-up looks like side by side: log cabins, wooden houses, garden saunas, hot tubs, camping pods, pergolas, gazebos and garden offices. Resellers and trade buyers source all of it from one supplier on wholesale terms — one order, one production line, one delivery — instead of managing separate suppliers for each category.

Recognise something for your own customers? Talk to our international team.
